description:
Terms of art ranked by how many instruments in this corpus DEFINE them, BORROW them from another act (followed through every intermediate act — an act that takes 'video-sharing platform' from the DSA, which takes it from the AVMSD, counts for the AVMSD's definition) or CITE a defining provision. Nothing in the list was chosen by hand. `tier` 'pivotal' means at least one act is written around the term — its duties are addressed to it, its other definitions build on it, its title and headings name it; 'shared' is a label many acts define, each for itself, that none turns on ('specified', 'prescribed'). Use it to find the anchoring concepts of an area — 'producer', 'economic operator', 'controller' — then call concept_family for one of them.

Each count is its own population: `reachWorks` is their union by work, never their sum. Quote them under their own names.
